_id: att rung: windupCorrected. att016 (Wu-1993 wind-up injected in TRUTH) with the estimator now CORRECTING it from its OWN estimated attitude. One toggle against att016. What survives z - h is the wind-up error CAUSED BY the attitude error, which is the physically meaningful coupling and the only reason this pair is an experiment rather than an identity.
_WHYTHISISNOTSELFCANCELLING: Truth computes the wind-up from the TRUE attitude and the TRUTH geometry; the model computes the same functional from the ESTIMATED attitude and the MODEL geometry. Two independent accumulators, keyed separately in ErrorChain so the continuations never share a cycle count. If they were the same object the rung would subtract itself to zero and measure nothing, which is the failure mode every truth/model pair in this repo has to be checked against.
_PREREGISTEREDPREDICTION_THECOUPLINGISSU: Recorded before the run. Wind-up responds at exactly one cycle per relative revolution, so d(range)/d(attitude about the line of sight) = lambda/(2*pi). At L1 that is 0.030286 m/rad = 0.529 mm/deg; on the ionosphere-free rows the EKF actually uses it is the NARROW-LANE wavelength, 0.017023 m/rad = 0.297 mm/deg. att010 carries an attitude error of ~0.95 deg, so the residual wind-up error after correcting with the estimated attitude is ~0.28 mm on the IF rows, and only the LOS COMPONENT of the attitude error contributes. Predict: no movement in any metric beyond floating-point noise, and predict the same for att016 for the different reason that the term is constant there. If att017 moves and att016 does not, the correction is INJECTING error rather than removing it and the sign convention is wrong.
_PREREGISTEREDPREDICTION_ITBUYSNOTHIRDAX: The handoff's second hypothesis was that wind-up might ADD third-axis observability, because it is sensitive to rotation ABOUT THE LINE OF SIGHT -- precisely the axis the differenced-carrier geometry is weak on by ~1/sin(10 deg) ~ 6. That hypothesis is now testable rather than rhetorical, because the estimator-side correction makes h depend on attitude through wind-up and CarrierMeasurementBuilder adds the matching partial to H (an h whose H omits one of its own dependencies is the inconsistent-triple defect this repo has on record, so it was closed rather than left). PREDICT IT FAILS, on arithmetic: the wind-up partial is 0.297 mm/deg on the IF rows against a geometric attitude partial of 18 / 4.8 / 34.9 mm per deg in the single difference, so it is ~16x below even the weakest geometric axis. Predict finalAttitudeSigma_deg is unchanged. Two ways it could still surprise: the wind-up partial is exactly aligned with the weak axis while the geometric one is not, and unlike the geometric partial it does not cancel in a difference -- but it also never enters the differenced path at all, since DiffAttitudeBuilder builds its own model from modelRangeOnly and never sees h_phi.
_WHATWOULDMAKETHISRUNGBITE: Nothing in the nadir-locked GEO case, and that is the finding. To make wind-up a real error source the spacecraft has to ROTATE relative to the line of sight: a non-zero cfg.asset.angularRate_body_radps, a yaw-steering law, or a commanded slew. That is a separate rung with its own toggle and is deliberately NOT bundled here, because mixing a wind-up toggle with an attitude-dynamics toggle would make neither attributable.
_THELIVENESSDISCRIMINATORS: phaseWindupNLinks must DOUBLE against att016, from 40 to 80, because the model side now accumulates its own 40 link-sides. phaseWindupCorrectionActive must be true. If phaseWindupNLinks stays 40 the correction is declared and inert and every unchanged metric below is meaningless.
_THERESULT: MEASURED 3600 s. LIVENESS: '[PhaseWindup] APPLIED: 80 link-sides, 3601 epochs each ... truth=1 correct=1', so phaseWindupNLinks did double from att016's 40 and the correction is live. METRICS: finalAttitudeError_deg 1.04546144 against att016's 1.04811841 and att010's 1.03662395; finalAttitudeSigma_deg 1.00906949 against 1.00944524 and 1.00928671; err/sigma 1.03606. finalPositionRMS_m 2.119365547, which is att016's 2.119364899 to within 0.6 NANOMETRES. meanNIS 93.03399968. diffAttMeanNRows 12. So correcting recovers 0.00266 deg of att016's 0.01149 deg penalty -- about 23 percent of it -- and moves nothing else.
_THEFINDINGTHATWASNOTPREDICTED_CORRECTIN: The most interesting number here is a wind-up diagnostic, not an EKF metric. phaseWindupMaxMinusMin_cycles is 0.01162350 on this rung against 9.821174e-08 on att016 -- FIVE ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE MORE TIME VARIATION, with a drift of 0.00308951 cycles/hour. The reason is structural and worth stating plainly: the TRUTH-side wind-up is driven by the true attitude, which is constant in ECEF here, so it barely moves; the MODEL-side wind-up is driven by the ESTIMATED attitude, which moves as the filter converges. The residual W_truth - W_model is therefore LESS constant than W_truth alone. Since a constant per-link term is absorbed exactly by the float carrier ambiguity and a varying one is not, correcting wind-up with an estimated attitude converts a perfectly absorbable constant into a small drifting residual. It still helps here -- 23 percent of the penalty comes back -- because the constant OFFSET removed is larger than the variation introduced, 0.047 cycles against 0.0116. But the sign of the argument is not the obvious one, and on a scenario where the truth wind-up genuinely varies the trade would run the other way.
_HOWTHEPREDICTIONSFARED: COUPLING MAGNITUDE: predicted a sub-millimetre residual, ~0.28 mm, from the ~0.95 deg final attitude error. Measured driver is 0.0116 cycles = 1.24 mm at the narrow-lane wavelength, about 4x larger. The prediction used the FINAL attitude error where the right quantity is the attitude error's EXCURSION over the arc, which starts near 1.5 deg -- so the model was mis-specified rather than the arithmetic wrong. Order of magnitude correct. THIRD-AXIS OBSERVABILITY: predicted no gain, and the prediction HOLDS. finalAttitudeSigma_deg is 1.00906949 against att010's 1.00928671, a change of 2.2e-04 deg or 0.02 percent, which is not observability. The pre-registered arithmetic explains it: the wind-up attitude partial is lambda_NL/(2*pi) = 0.297 mm/deg against a geometric partial of 18 / 4.8 / 34.9 mm per deg, so it is ~16x below even the weakest geometric axis. The handoff's second hypothesis -- that wind-up might supply the line-of-sight axis the geometry cannot see -- is REFUTED for this configuration, and refuted with the Jacobian actually wired in rather than by assuming it away.
_THEHONESTLIMITOFTHISPAIR: att016 and att017 bound wind-up in the NADIR-LOCKED GEO case and nowhere else. cfg.asset.angularRate_body_radps is zero, the truth attitude is a constant ECEF Euler, and a GEO is nearly fixed in ECEF, so the input to the effect is static by construction. Every number here is a statement about that scenario. The rung that would actually stress wind-up gives the spacecraft a body rate or a yaw-steering law, and it is deliberately not bundled into this pair.
